dimension.name: Illumination & Radiation
dimension.goal: Issue #139: expand illumination and ionizing-radiation products separately with bounded, reproducible, provenance-backed coverage for Earth, Moon, and Mars.

generated_from.notes: Counts and coverage below reflect committed/bounded pilot artifacts in this repository snapshot. They are not a global or exhaustive survey.

global_non_claims: No global or exhaustive Earth/Moon/Mars illumination or radiation coverage is claimed.
No ionizing radiation absorbed dose (Gy), equivalent dose (Sv), shielding-adjusted dose, or particle-flux product is fabricated or unit-converted without a documented physics model.
No observed local irradiance, shadow fraction, horizon mask, or DEM-horizon visibility interval is claimed by the current SPICE pilot.
No cross-body D05 similarity score or mixed illumination+radiation aggregate is produced.
Missing, not-detected, zero, no_coverage, and unsupported are distinct states; absent data is never zero-filled.

assumptions: Point site on body-fixed biaxial ellipsoid reference; no DEM elevation or observer height applied.
Flat biaxial-ellipsoid tangent-plane normal; no terrain horizon, horizon mask, shadow fraction, or atmosphere/cloud model.
Light-time-corrected Sun direction from SPICE; site parallax applied by vector subtraction.
Moon frame MOON_ME realized from DE421; Mars frame IAU_MARS from pck00011; source projected-CRS-to-frame registration is a documented assumption.
Single instant only; no time series, eclipse/occultation, or local-solar-time series.
illumination_geometry_spice.missing_time_behavior: If epoch_utc is absent or unsupported for a query, the provider must return no_coverage/unsupported rather than a fixed global illumination value.
illumination_geometry_spice.kernel_validity: DE421 approximately 1900-2050; kernel SHA-256 digests pinned in pilot manifest/assets.

assumptions: NASA POWER daily point is coarse model/reanalysis context (~0.5 x 0.625 degree), not a local 1.98 km measurement.
All-sky surface shortwave/longwave irradiance only; not ionizing radiation, absorbed dose, or equivalent dose.
No per-point uncertainty provided by source; uncertainty retained as unknown rather than invented.
Fill/missing sentinels are excluded and never converted to zero.
earth_irradiance_nasa_power.missing_time_behavior: Requests outside supported temporal coverage or with missing interval must be reported as unsupported/no_coverage, not substituted.

assumptions: Particle flux, absorbed dose, equivalent dose, shielding, sensor geometry, and exposure time must remain separate fields/products.
No Gy<->Sv or flux<->dose conversion without an explicit, cited physics/calibration model and applicable geometry.
ionizing_radiation.missing_time_behavior: If exposure interval, calibration, or geometry assumptions are missing, return unsupported rather than a nominal dose/flux.

representative_queries.note: Representative queries below are reproducible against committed pilot artifacts (offline, file-backed). They demonstrate actual queryable coverage states per body where data exists and explicit absence where unsupported.

commands.purpose: List committed Earth D05 illumination irradiance observations and areas
commands.command: python3 -c "import json; obs=[json.loads(l) for l in open('pipelines/pilots/d05_earth_power/observations.jsonl') if l.strip()]; print({'count':len(obs),'areas':sorted({o['area_id'] for o in obs}),'features':sorted({o['feature_id'] for o in obs}),'states':sorted({o['state'] for o in obs})})"
